authority: Session 813 Framework v2 Operational Adoption Review

aggregation1_throughputSynthesis.title: Throughput Synthesis (W1 + W2)

governanceGuard.interpretation: MODERATE variability. W2 governance guard is 40.6% slower than W1. Possible causes: larger candidate set (282 vs 242 blocked), DL-026 per-field cost, or pack-file size growth.

identityValidator.interpretation: VERY STABLE. Identity validation is consistent across waves. CV < 0.04 indicates a deterministic, well-tuned validator. 2,539/2,540 PASS (99.96%) is reliable.

orchestrator.interpretation: LOW variability. Orchestrator overhead increased 13.7% from W1 to W2. Acceptable for the infrastructure layer - likely reflects additional delta-review bookkeeping.

pipelineThroughput.interpretation: HIGH variability. W2 throughput dropped 36.3% from W1. This is the weakest signal in the throughput synthesis. Likely cause: W2 ran the full 282-item BLOCKED pool (vs W1's 242-item readiness set), adding per-item block-reason enrichment overhead. Candidate engine overhead in W2 (S850 spec generation at 14:59) also consumed shared infrastructure.

aggregation1_throughputSynthesis.verdict: PASS_WITH_CAVEAT. Core metrics stable (identity CV < 4%, orchestrator CV < 10%). Pipeline degradation (36%, CV 31%) needs investigation before adoption finalization.

dl012Archival.description: Clonal redundancy from template-based authoring. 28 clone groups × 5 items = 140 items, 11 are unique seeds (preserved), 129 are clones (archivable). NO authoring required — archival operation only.

dl026Authoring.description: Empty non-CorrectChoice ExplanationWrong slots. Items need choice-specific distractor authoring (≥50 chars per slot, COSO/ASC-principled). Each item typically has 1-2 empty distractor slots.
dl026Authoring.effort: At WAVE_A rate (77 items/wave): 153/77 = 1.99 → 2 authoring waves. Estimated 2 calendar sessions.

conditions: CONDITION A — Pipeline Degradation: W2 throughput dropped 36.3% (3,175→2,024 items/sec, CV 0.31). Must stabilize pipeline above 2,500 items/sec before full production adoption. Root-cause the W1→W2 degradation.

CONDITION B — DL-012 Archival First: Execute 129-item DL-012 archival wave before committing to full-scale DL-026 authoring. This validates the archival pipeline path and immediately lifts certification from 90.47% to 95.55%.

CONDITION C — Domain E Remediation Plan: 40 Domain E DL-026 items are the hardest remaining work. Establish achievable timeline with explicit per-item authoring standards before committing the full 153-item DL-026 wave.
CONDITION D — app.js Hash Stability: Any pre-delivery safety check must confirm app.js hash matches CURRENT_BASELINES.md before production adoption (per Session 52 Sync Anomaly Playbook).

CONDITION E — Known-Defective Exclusion: The 39 Domain F items certified with DL-026 represent known learner-pool defects. Must be flagged in pre-delivery safety check and excluded from live-simulation delivery until remediated (per AGENTS.md §7).
rationale.expectedResolutionTimeline: Conditions A-E resolvable within 3-4 calendar days. Full adoption viable by 2026-07-31.
